Jaipur  ·  Est. 2012  ·  Made to Measure

The bride wears a thousand hands.

Leheriya, gota patti and hand-block silks from our own karigar families. Every Aarohi piece is cut once, for one woman, and finished in-house over 40 to 90 hours.

View Bridal ’26 Book a Studio Visit

We do not buy stock and re-sell it. Our block printer sits in Sanganer, our gota workshop in Johari Bazaar, and our tailors cut every piece to one woman’s measurements. If it leaves our studio unfinished, it does not leave at all.

The Atelier

Six karigar families. One roof. No shortcuts.

Fourteen years in the same C-Scheme lane. The masters who block your fabric are the same hands that finished your mother’s bridal dupatta — that is the whole point of Aarohi.
